content: Ketsutsi kemɨrenayehɨa tewi nawi kwiniyayari mexeiyakai
Merikɨtsɨ kepauka yemuritsie makane, teɨteri yumɨiretɨ mekaniweiyakaitɨni.
Hikɨ tewi nawi kwiniyayari mexeiyakai hetsɨana nuaka hɨxiena 'utitunumakeka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'aitame, xɨka pe'awaɨriyani, pepɨyɨwe pemɨnetsi'itieni.
Ketsutsi yumamá 'utatseraka kanimayɨani, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Nepɨnewaɨriya. Pekaniu'itiyaniri. Hikɨ yapauka kwiniyaya neunuani, 'itiyatɨ kanayani.

Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxei, xeimetɨma pepɨkaraxaxatɨwani, mawari wewiwame hetsɨa pɨta kenemie kene'ahekɨata matsihexeiyakɨ, meta 'imikieri kenanutimawa kemɨtiu'aitaxɨ Muitsexi yapemɨtiwatahekɨatɨanikɨ.
Kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame yuri kemɨti'eriekai
Merikɨtsɨ Kaperunaume kiekariyaritsie heutahaku kuya hetsɨana kaninuani xeitsienituyari kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame, mɨkɨ waɨriyarika kanipitɨani
mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Ti'aitame 'aku, neti'uximayatsiriwame nekiita payeka hurietɨ kwiyɨanetɨ kwiniyakɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ne nekanimieni 'aixɨa reu'eriekame nemayeitɨanikɨ.
Kuya rehɨawe: —Ti'aitame, 'aixɨa nepɨka'ane nekiita pemeutahanikɨ, niukikɨ xeikɨa yakeneutayɨki, mɨkɨkɨ panayehɨiyani neti'uximayatsiriwame.

Netatsiere nekatini'aitɨarieka nekuyatɨtɨ, meta kuyaxi nepɨtiwa'aitɨwame. Xɨka mɨpaɨ netitahɨawe xeime: “Kenemie”, mɨkɨ pɨyemie. Xeimeta mɨpaɨ xɨka netiutahɨawe: “Kenaye'a”, mɨkɨ kanayeimɨkɨ. Xɨka mɨpaɨ netitahɨawe neti'uximayatsiriwame: “'Ipaɨ ketineyurieneni”, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ pɨtiyurieni.

Ketsutsi 'i'enieka nihɨxiyakaitɨni, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe mɨkɨ memikuweiyatɨwekai: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, nixeime tɨma 'ixaheritsixi watsata 'ikɨ hepaɨ 'aneme nepɨkakaxeiyawe yuri ti'eriekame.

Mɨpaɨ nepɨtixekɨhɨawe, yumɨiretɨ mekani'axɨakuni tau manatineika hepatsie kiekatari meta makayuyuipike hepatsie kiekatari, 'Apɨrahami, 'Itsahaki meta Kakuwu wahamatɨa mekaniutiyaxikuni hakewa mɨre'aita taheima makawe.
Peru mɨkɨ mana memeutahaxɨanikekai mɨpaɨ 'ayumieme memutinunuiwakai, mɨkɨ mekananuyexɨriyakuni takwa yɨwipa yemekɨ memu'uwanikɨ, mana meniutitsuanakuni meniyutakewekuni.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame katiniutahɨawe: —Kenemie. Yuri kepemɨti'erie, mɨpaɨ pɨtiyɨni. 'Anatɨtɨ 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ kanayani ti'uximayatame mɨkɨ hurayaritsie.
Yumɨireme kemɨtiwaranayexɨri
Hikɨ kepauka Ketsutsi Pekuru kie munua, warɨkaɨya kaniuxeiya yu'utatsie kakaime hɨiyakame.
Mamayatsie kanimayɨani, hikɨ hɨiya kanihayewa. Hikɨ mɨkɨ 'anukukeka katiniwarumini.

Hikɨ taikai, mekani'atɨirieni yumɨireme teɨteri kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene memɨwawiyakai, hikɨ kakaɨyarixi niwarayenɨ'ani xeiniukiyarikɨ, 'ana yunaime 'aixɨa meteheu'eriekame kaniwarayeitɨani memɨtekukuyekai.
Mɨpaɨ tiuyurieku, paye'a Kakaɨyari niukameya Kitsariyaxi kemutayɨ:
Kemɨtikwaniwe Ketsutsi muweiyanikɨ
Merikɨtsɨ Ketsutsi waxeiyatɨ teɨteri kememɨteyuxeɨriekai 'auriena yumɨiretɨ, kaniuyuta'aita harakuna 'anutaɨye paitɨ manutuiyanikɨ.
Hikɨ xewitɨ 'inɨarikɨ mɨti'ɨkitametɨkai hetsɨana nuaka, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'ɨkitame 'aku, 'ahetsie nekatiniwiyamɨkɨ, hakewa pemeyemie neta nekaniyemieni 'a'utɨma.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Kauxaitsi yuterɨ mepexeiya, wikixi yu'itua mepexeiyata, peru ne, Yuri Tewi kenemɨtitewa, nepɨkaheixeiya hakewa nemeyukamuritɨani.
Xewitɨta tiyu'ɨkitɨwame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'aitame, keneneupitɨa meri nemɨyemiekɨ nepaapa nemɨteukimiekɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Nehetsie ketineuwiya, mɨkite keniwaruhayewa, mɨkɨ mɨkite yuhetsɨa miemete mekewarukateuku.
Ketsutsi 'eka kemɨreunuitɨa
Merikɨtsɨ kanuwatsie kayerɨka Ketsutsi meta teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama yunaitɨ mekanekɨne.
Hikɨ harakunatsie me'uyehukaku kaniuyutawewieni 'eka waɨkawa tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ hikɨ hamewari kanuwatsie kanakayeuriwekaitɨni. Ketsutsi matsi kanikutsukaitɨni.
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete hetsɨana me'u'axɨaka mekanenutahɨtɨani, mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —Ti'aitame, ketaneutawikweitsitɨa, tepeuyewexime.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: ―Teɨteri 'etsiwa xeikɨa yuri xemɨte'erie, ¿titayari xetemama waɨkawa? Hikɨ 'anukukeka 'eka kaniutatieni meta hamewari, hikɨ naitɨ kayuwatɨ kaniutamare.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ teyu'ɨkitɨwamete mekanihɨxiyakaitɨni, mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «¿Tita tewiyari tihɨkɨ 'ikɨ, 'atsita 'eka meta hamewari memei'enie?»
Kakaɨyarixi kememɨtewawiyakai Katarenatari

Merikɨtsɨ 'anutaɨye paitɨ heta'aku Ketsutsi, katarenatari wakwietsie paitɨ, yuhutatɨ teɨteri kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene memɨwawiyakai teukiyapa mehayenexɨaka mekanenukunake. Kwinimieme metenayu'eririyakaitɨni, 'ayumieme hipatɨ mepɨkayuwaɨriyakai mana memuyekɨnekɨ.
Merikɨtsɨ mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenihiwieni: —¿Ketita perayexeiya, Kakaɨyari nu'aya? ¿'Ena petinua petatsi'uximatɨanike tukari ka'aye'awekaku 'akuxi?
Merikɨtsɨ mana memanu'uwakaitsie yatewa mekatenikwatɨwekaitɨni tuixuri yumɨiretɨ.
Kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene menitawawirieni mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: —Xɨka petatsi'ayenɨ'amɨkɨ, ketaneupitɨa tuixuri temɨwawiyakɨ.

Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xekenehu. Hikɨ mɨkɨ mekanayekɨne teɨteri wahetsie tuixuri wahetsie pɨta mekaneutahaxɨani, hikɨ yunaitɨ tuixuri mekaniutinautsa tekɨata mekaneukaxɨrieni harakunapa, hapa mekaniukwini.
Hikɨ tuixuri wahɨwemete mekaniyuta'una, hikɨ kiekaritsie me'uxɨaka naime mekateniutaxata meta kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene memɨwawiyakai kememu'itɨariekai.
'Ayumieme yunaitɨ teɨteri kiekatari mekanayekɨne Ketsutsi me'anukunakeke. Hikɨ kepauka memixei waɨriyarika mekanipitɨani mɨyemiekɨ wakwiepa mɨka'uyeikanikɨ.
